notes.subject: hon
notes.rationale: קרן (hon bilong bulmakau) em i tok bilong strong na klok; tanim olsem 'strong' tasol bai lusim piksa

notes.subject: santu bilong olgeta man khesed
notes.rationale: תהלה i ken tok 'em i santu bilong ol' o 'ol i santu em'; KJV na JPS i tanim olsem daunbilo

notes.subject: Santu Ya
notes.rationale: Hallelu-Ya — kolim ol manmeri long laspela tok bilong psalm

notes.subject: ol pikinini bilong Yisrael
notes.rationale: em i tok stret long ol pikinini bilong Yisrael, ol man i klostu long Yahwe

translation: Na em i antapim hon bilong ol man bilong en, santu bilong olgeta man khesed bilong en, bilong ol pikinini bilong Yisrael, ol man i klostu long em. Santu Ya!
